Commentary.Commentary: Alex Carey has now been presented the trophy and he along with his teammates can now celebrate! That is it from our end for this series. We hope you enjoyed our coverage, please do join us for the games which are going to be played ahead. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Alex Carey says the commitment the group has shown is really good, the T20 series did not go their way but he is pleased with this performance. States it is very exciting to captain your country and it was a good team effort, the chase was a little bit ugly but on such a wicket it is fine and he is happy they bounced back strongly. Mentions the bowlers work really hard, they know their skills and it is good to have them in the side. Ends by saying, he has a lot of support throughout this series and he is very pleased with a series win.

Mitchell Starc, Man of the Series, says there have been plenty of ups and downs and he feels bowling is their strength as there is experience but the batting learned from the last game and did well. Adds it helps with Josh Hazlewood bowling from the other end, who is excellent and the spinners too are really good. Also says it is nice to do it against the Windies in Windies and he is pleased to contribute.

Kieron Pollard says they did not bat well, they did the hard work initially but then later on lost too many wickets, 153 was never going to be enough. States it has been challenging for them, they have not batted well in this series, both teams struggled on this wicket which was not a good pitch. Adds Akeal Hosein delivered, Hayden Walsh and Alzarri Joseph were also good. Ends by saying the Aussies were better and he hopes to concentrate on the games coming ahead

Ashton Agar, Man of the Match, says he always tries to do something special but it was an honor to give his brother the cap and he loves him. Mentions it was good conditions for the spinners and it was all about hitting the right lines and lengths. States it is always good to do it in a decider and he really wanted to win and he feels great. Ends by saying it is very special, the conditions were not easy, you do not get a lot of pitches like that and he hopes they get more such pitches.
Stay tuned for the Presentation...

The Windies' bowling wasn’t that bad. Akeal Hosein was once again impressive, Hayden Walsh also had a decent outing. However, the pacers conceded far too many runs and that too quickly which just took the game away from them. Also, that drop of Alex Carey quite early in his innings also cost them. However, their batters let them down, they just did not have enough runs on the board.

After their bowlers with a combined effort, restricted the Windies to a low total, it was just about batting smart and that is what a few of their batsmen did. Yes, they did lose wickets at regular intervals but Alex Carey, Matthew Wade and Ashton Agar really played spin well and took their side over the line. The plan to keep sending left-handers when the spinners were bowling turned out to be a master stroke.
A very comfortable chase in the end for the Aussies and with that effort, they have not only won the game but also the series.
THERE IT IS! WADE HITS THE WINNING RUN! On middle, he pushes it towards cover for one. AUSTRALIA WIN BY 6 WICKETS!

DROPPED AND FOUR! Fifty for Wade! He would have been gutted with himself had he been dismissed on that ball. Immediately after playing the shot, he looked up in disappointment as he knew he was a goner but he got lucky. A full toss on off, he lofts it straight towards covers. Bravo there lets it through his hands and to the boundary. A really good innings, he played with a lot of responsibility and has played a vital role in taking his side over the line. SCORES NOW LEVEL!
Fuller and on off, Agar pushes it through covers for one.
A dot to end! Wade remains on 46 and Australia still need 6. Floats it on middle, defended.
Flatter and on off, Wade pushes it to covers.
Shuffles across and then looks to sweep, the ball hits his hand and then the pads of the keeper.
FOUR! Just a big hit away now are the Aussies and Wade just a boundary away! Short and outside off, Wade slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Leading edge but safe! The googly on the pads, Wade looks to work it agains the turn on the leg side but it goes off a soft leading edge on the off side.
SIX! Australia charging near to the victory! Pitches it up on middle. Wade gets into the position and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Length ball outside off. Wade opens his bat face and guides it to third man for one.
Outside off, this is driven through point for a single.
Full and around off. Blocked out.
A slower short ball outside off. Agar dabs it late towards backward point.
Another length ball outside off. Agar slaps it to point.
On a length and around off. Agar blocks it out.
Full and on off. Wade defends it out.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to square leg.

NOT OUT! Pitches it up, full and around middle and leg. Wade prods forward to defend it but seems to miss it. The square leg fielder takes the catch as well. The umpire raises his finger. Wade straightaway goes for the review. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball tracking shows wickets missing. Good review from him.
An appeal and Wade has been given out caught! He reviews. Nothing on Ultra Edge so now the LBW is being checked but the ball is going over.
Full and on middle. Blocked out.
SIX! Just 18 runs needed now! Serves another shorter ball on middle. Wade rocks back and pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Serves a shorter ball on off. Agar pulls it to long on for one run.
Around off. Wade solidly blocks it out.
A short ball angling on middle. Wade hops and blocks it out off his shoulders of his bat.
Touch fuller on off. Agar pushes it through point for a single.
On a length and on off. Agar blocks it out.
FOUR! Australia in a hurry now! A short ball way outside off. Agar frees his arms and slashes it over point for a boundary.
A short ball outside off. Wade dabs it to short third man for a single.
Outside off, full ball. Agar pushes it on the off side.
FOUR! Was that a chance? A slower short ball on middle. Agar rocks back, clears his front leg and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another outside off ball. Agar pushes it to point.
Tossed up outside off. Defended.
Now flicks it with the angle towards square leg for one more.
Flatter ball outside off. Wade swivels across and blocks it out.
Shorter ball outisde off. Agar pulls it off the inner half, back to the bowler.
Very full on middle. Squeezed back to the bowler.
Again full but this time outside off. Agar looks to push but misses it completely.
On middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Well played! Pitches it up on middle. Agar drives it through diving mid off for a boundary.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a full ball outside off. Wade strides forward and sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
this time goes on the back foot to flick it away to square leg. 41 runs more needed.
Tossed up, fuller on off. Agar lunges forward to blocks it out.
Prods forward this time to defend it out.
Full and way outside off. Agar misses his push.
WIDE! this one lands on middle, and turns sharply down the leg side. Left alone. Wided.
Loopy ball on middle. Agar punches off the back foot to mid on.
Full and angling down. Agar gets his leg out through.
Full and outside off. Wade prods to defend but gets a thick outside edge to short third man.
A shorter ball on off. Agar pulls it, not off the middle of his blade, towards deep square leg for one.
Floated it on off. Agar rocks back and punches it back to the bowler.
Three taken! Darted on the pads. Wade ticks it fine past short fine leg for three runs.
Flatter on middle. Wade clips it to square leg.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! This is tossed up, a little too full, Wade creams it through covers for a bounary.
WIDE! 50 more needed! Down the leg side, Wade looks to flick but misses.
Darts it in on middle, this one too turns back in. Agar looks to flick but again misses and gets hit on the pads.
Floats it up on off this time, Agar lunges and keeps it out.
Flatter and on middle, this one turns back in. Agar looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Almost a run out! On middle, this is hit back towards the bowler who gets down and tries to stop, it hits his hand and deflects towards the opposite direction of the stumps and goes towards mid off for one.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Loopy ball on middle. Wade flicks it wide of mid-wicket. Pollard there does well to stop it.
Again on the pads, this is flicked to the leg side.
Flatter ball on middle. Wade rocks back and flicks it to the leg side.

Very full on middle. Agar squeezes it out to mid of for a quick single. The mid off fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end. The TV umpire has a quick look and seems fine with the on-field decision.

OUT! LBW! The Windies needed this wicket so badly! A quicker tossed up ball, fuller and angling on middle and leg. Alex Carey goes for the sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Hayden Walsh appeals but the umpire says no. They go for the review straightaway. Ultra Edge shows no bat. Ball Tracker shows three reds and Carey has to walk back. A good innings from him but Windies now have a sniff.
All happening out there! A run out appeal now but Wade seems fine.
Ashton Agar walks out to bat now!
A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down! Windies review. Seems like there is bat.
Had there been a short leg, it would have been a chance! On middle, this too turns back in. Wade prods forward to defend, it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
How has that missed the off pole? This lands outside off and then spins in sharply. Wade looks to push it through the off side but it goes just over the off pole as Wade misses.
Two more! Stays leg side of this shortish ball and pushes it through covers.
On middle, defended.
Close! This lands outside off and then spins back in. Wade looks to push at it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fires it full and on middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, Wade pushes it towards cover. He wants one but is sent back.
The reverse sweep, it is hit through point for one.
Well fielded! A low full toss on off, this is hit through covers. The fielder at mid off runs, slides and pushes it back in. Saves a run for his side.
The googly on middle, defended.
On the pads, Carey works it through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is worked to short fine leg.
Flatter and on off, this one holds in the surface. Wade guides it to point.
Flatter and outside off, left alone.
Another single as this is pushed down to long off.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
FOUR! Pulled away! This is way too short and on off, Wade pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, kept out.

Gives it flight and lands it on off, this one turns back in. Carey tries to block but it goes off the inner half on the leg side. This is the pace he should be bowling at and not as flat as he has been for most of his overs.
Flatter this time and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
And again, nice and slow, it lands around off and turns back in. Wade once again gets an inside edge onto the pads as he tries to defend.
Slows it up and lands it outside off. This one turns back in. Wade looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flatter and on off, defended.
On off, this is swept through square leg for one.
Full and way outside off. Carey drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle. Carey blocks it out.
FOUR! Freebie! A full toss on off. Carey drives it through covers. The long off runs across, dives but in vain.
Flatter on middle. Wade rocks back and flicks it on the leg side for one.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Wade defends it out.
Starts with a slower short ball outside off. Left alone.
Kieron Pollard is into the attack.
Two more! Hosein fires it full and on middle, Carey sweeps it fine this time for two.
Once again Carey plays the sweep but this time to short fine leg.
Angled into the pads, Wade goes back and works it through square leg for one.
Another sweep shot, it is hit through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
A full toss, Carey sweeps it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Off the mark as well! A length ball outside off. Wade slashes it over point for a boundary.
A short of a length ball on off. Wade hops and taps it to backward point.
WIDE! Another sharp bouncer outside off. Left alone. Wided.
WIDE! A pacy short ball on middle. Wade ducks under it. Wide given for height.

DRINKS! Windies just about in this game! They had to break this stand which was taking the game away from them quickly and they have done so. However, they need to keep taking wickets. Can this wicket now open the floodgates? Australia on the other hand, know that they need another one partnership like that and they will win it. An important passage of play awaits. Meanwhile, Matthew Wade is the new man in.

OUT! GLOVED AND TAKEN! What was turning out to be a disastrous plan has worked out in the end. Yes, the short ball ploy has gone for plenty of runs but it has got the wicket they wanted. Australia still need 88 runs. This is short and on the body, Marsh looks to pull, it goes off the glove and the keeper leaps to his left and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A full toss and it is put away! Cottrell has not been good! He probably is going for a yorker but ends up serving a full toss on off, this is pushed through covers for a boundary.
TOP EDGE and SIX! Do not think this short ball is the right one against Marsh! This is short and on the body, Marsh looks to pull again, this goes off the top edge and over the third man fence.
Slightly fuller and on middle, Marsh pushes it back to the bowler.
Sheldon Cottrell will switch the ends.
A dot to end! The googly on middle, blocked.
Clever! Plays the paddle sweep and does so nicely, it runs fine on the leg side for two.
Flatter and it is the googly, Marsh does not pick it, he looks to push it through the off side but this goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg for one.
This time sweeps it nicely through square leg for one.

Has Joseph dropped the game? These chances need to be taken when you are behind in the game! Carey looks to reverse sweep this as it lands outside off, there is extra bounce. It goes off the top edge towards backward point where Joseph dives forward and gets two hands to it but spills it.
Floats it up outside off, Carey gets his front leg outside the line of off and then tries to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Hayden Walsh is into the attack.
And again, just opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
Back of a length and on off, Carey guides it to point.
50 up for Australia! Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Marsh swivels and looks to pull but the ball does not bounce as much as he expected it to, gets hit on the thigh pad.
Good length and on off, blocked.

SIX! Whipped away! Trademark Marsh! This is bread and butter stuff for him! Full and on the pads, this is heaved over the square leg fence for a biggie. Game slipping away now. Two sixes in the last 7 balls. Just the 104 more needed.
Two dots to end but a really good over for Australia! Shorter and on middle, this one skids through again. Carey misses the flick and is hit on the body.
Back of a length and on off, Carey guides it to point.
WIDE! Another short one but this is way too short. Left alone. Wided.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.

SIX! Goes over! Don't think Hetmyer who misjudged it would have had a chance even if he would have judged it well. A short one and on the body, Marsh pulls, he does not time it well but it is with the wind. Hetmyer runs in initially but then goes back, it goes over his head for a biggie.
Outside off again, Carey opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.
Lovely stuff! Length and around off, this one holds its line and zips through. Carey is beaten as he tries to defend.
Powerplay 2 signaled! Now a total of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Sheldon Cottrell is also back.
Just a single! Around off. Carey guides it through diving point who half-stops it. The third man comes across and cuts it off.
TAP AND RUN! A length ball on middle. Marsh tucks it to mid on for a quick single.
Full and on off. Marsh drives it to mid off.
A short ball outside off. Carey dabs it to third man for a single.
A length ball way outside off. Carey goes for a big slash but misses it.
A short of a length ball on off. Carey hops and taps it under his eyes.
On middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Pitches it up, on off, it lands and spins away. Marsh goes for a sweep but misses it completely.
Floats it up on middle. Marsh rocks back and flicks it to deep square leg for two.
Full on middle. Marsh sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
SWING AND A MISS! A flatter and quicker ball way outside off. Marsh slashes at it but misses.
And again! Pollard is going out of the field for safety measures he is not standing at short leg.
NO BALL! On middle. Marsh sweeps it to on the leg side. Ohh wait... No ball called for overstepping. Free Hit coming up.
A short ball, drifting in, on middle. Marsh gets on his knee and slogs it. Hits it to Pollard at short leg who deflects it wide of the bowler.
On the pads. Carey flicks it to square leg. Good over from Joseph as he strikes in his very first over.
Off the mark straightaway! Short ball on middle. Pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Mitchell Marsh walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Josh Philippe would have been wiser if he left that alone! A full ball angling way down the leg side. Josh Philippe is tempted to go for the whack but ends up getting an edge to the keeper who shuffles to his left and takes it cleanly. Australia are 2 down now and Windies believe.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball on middle. Carey pulls it away to square leg for one more.
On a length and on middle. Josh Philippe punches off the back foot through mid on for one.
Serves a full ball outside off. Pushes it to covers.
Alzarri Joseph is on now!
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
On middle, again goes for the reverse sweep but mistimes it to covers.
Tossed up on middle. Carey drills it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This time he connects and connects it very well! A full ball on middle. Carey sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! A full ball angling way down. Carey goes for the reverse sweep but misses it. Wide signaled.
Full ball angling around off. Carey goes for the sweeps but misses it. Windies optimistically appeal for it. Had some gloves on it.
On middle. Josh Philippe paddles it to deep square leg for a single.
Appeal but turned down! A back of a length ball around off. Carey waits for it and looks to cut it but misses it. They appeal for caught behind but the umpire is unmoved.
Length ball on off. Carey slaps it to cover-point.
IN THE AIR... Safe! Another full ball on off. Carey lofts it over mid off. The ball does not race away to the fence, hence two runs collected.
Another full ball outside off. Carey lets it through.
Full and outside off. Carey slices it high in the air and towards the vacant deep point region. Two taken in the end.
On a length around off. Carey taps it to point.
Tossed up outside off. Josh Philippe defends it to covers. Maiden for Akeal Hosein.
On middle. Josh Philippe blocks it out.

NOT OUT! That was very close! A full ball way outside off, spinning away as well. Philippe is up for an expansive drive but misses it completely. Pooran behind the stumps collects it and removes the bails off. The TV umpire has a check and says the foot was grounded when the bails were clipped off.
Is that a stumping? They have taken it upstairs. Looks close. Windies not that confident.
Tossed up, on off. Josh Philippe rocks back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter again on middle. Josh Philippe blocks it on the leg side.
Flatter and quicker around off. Pushed back to he bowler.
Touch fuller on middle. Carey blocks it out.
On middle. Carey defends it under his eyes. The ball lobs just around the stump.
Length ball way outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! A short of a length ball outside off. Carey looks to go over covers but manages a thick outside edge, over the slip cordan and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Length ball outside off. Carey taps it to point.
Around off, on a length. Carey blocks it on the ground.
End of a successful first over by Hosein! This is fired outside off, Josh looks to sweep but it spins away and he gets beaten.
Floats it up now, this comes in with the angle, Josh plays it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, Josh pushes it to mid off.
Off the mark rightaway! Sweeps this through square leg and takes one.

OUT! LBW! This time Akeal Hosein strikes and the Windies get the early breakthrough they were looking for! Hosein serves a flatter ball, it drifts in and zips through after landing. Heriques misreads the length and goes back to a delivery he should be playing ahead to. Misses and gets hit on the pads. The Windies are once again already celebrating as they appeal and the finger is raised immediately. Perfect start for the hosts. Also, this is the third time in this series AK has got MH.

NOT OUT! No bat on it! Henriques survives! This is fired into the pads, Henriques tries to flick, there are two noises as the ball lobs to Pollard at short leg who takes it. He is celebrating but the umpire is not sure. He has a chat with the other umpire and then takes it upstairs with the soft signal being out. He probably feels there is an inside edge but want to check if it is a bump ball. Replays show that the bat had hit the pad.

Straightaway Hosein causes problems! An appeal for a catch at short leg. The umpires get together to have a word. They want to check if it is a bump ball and they take it upstairs. SOFT SIGNAL IS OUT!
Akeal Hosein is on! Spin introduced early and rightly so. We all believe if Windies are to win, the spinners have to do majority of the work.
Another length ball on off. Josh Philippe defends it to covers.
This is good bowling from Holder, keeping the length and line in the channel. Around off. Blocked out.
On a length and outside off. This is blocked on the off side.
Full ball, shaping away outside off. Josh Philippe is solid in his defense.
A short of a length ball on middle. Moises Henriques rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg to get off the mark with a single.
Length ball way outside off. Moises Henriques lets it through.
Length ball on middle. Josh tucks it to mid-wicket.
Jason Holder to bowl from the other end!
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side. Left alone. Wide signaled.
FOUR! EDGY RUNS! A length ball outside off. Josh Philippe hangs his bat out and looks to leave it away but manages an inside edge, past the keeper and towards the fine leg fence.
Drags his length back a bit, on middle. Josh Philippe stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for two more.
On the pads, this is flicked to deep square leg for a couple of runs. Australia and Josh Philippe are off the mark.
Good delivery! Another good length ball, swinging in, on middle and leg. Josh Philippe misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Starts with a good length ball, angling across, outside off. Josh Philippe shoulders arms to it.
